name: novel-forge
description: 成长型小说生成桌面软件（Electron + React + Python Sidecar + Ollama）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n main,renderer -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/main" "npm run dev -w apps/renderer"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/shared && npm run build -w apps/main && npm run build -w apps/renderer
